network.description:
Network specified in the request. Supported values;
- mainnet
- testnet
- devnet

page.description: The current page number sent in the request.

total.description: Total number of stake accounts being sent in the API response

data.description: An array that contains the details about stake accounts.

stake_account.description: The public key of the stake account

balance_in_sol.description: The current balance of the stake account in SOL. Values will be displayed up to 9 decimal places

balance_in_lamports.description: The balance in the stake account in Lamports

ProvisionInfo.description: JSON object that contains the registration details of the delegator.

id.description: The reference number issued when successfully onboarding the stake account

created_at.description: Created date and time in the platform. This should be YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in UTC.

ValidatorInfo.description: JSON object that represents the validator for which the given stake account is attached to.

address.description: The public key of the validator
